deviations: Inflation adjustment: the paper does not give its deflator; contributions (totalcont) are converted to 2018 dollars with CPI-U annual averages (2013 = 232.957, 2018 = 251.107), using the vote year's CPI for every window.

Window-to-file mapping inferred from the data: SugarReplicate.dta = baseline window (largest totals, nests the others); SugarReplicate_iter2.dta = calendar year of the vote (larger 2018 total, smaller 2013 total, consistent with the fall-2012 and fall-2018 election-season giving); SugarReplicate_iter1.dta = 12 months before the vote. The variable sugcont is identical across files and is not used (taken to be the cycle-aggregated measure of the paper's Appendix A.3).

Fixed-effects logit estimated as unconditional ML with fixed-effect dummies (fixest::feglm, binomial), which drops districts or incumbents whose vote did not change; heteroskedasticity-robust SEs. ACU score is the data's ncu variable.
notes: Outcome y = 1 if vote == 'Aye', 0 otherwise (No, Not Voting, No Vote). Controls: ACU (ncu), tenure, poverty, bach, medincome, over65, agcom; fixed effects on the district id (state_no*100 + district). Rows with missing covariates dropped (2 rows), leaving 93 vote-switching districts (186 obs), matching the paper's 93. Incumbent sample: districts where both rows have both == 1 (same member cast both votes); 53 switching incumbents (106 obs), matching the paper's 53; FE on district id, which equals incumbent FE in this sample (one switching pair has inconsistent cid codes across the two congresses, so grouping by cid would give 52). Three exploratory runs (attempt-1..3, no RESULT lines) inspected variables, contribution totals by file and switching counts; the replication Read Me (.docx) was read as data documentation. No script files in the package were opened. All work ran from the scratch dir <scratch>/.../cells/grier-blind-4 and was copied here.
